files.name: Welcome
files.body:
# Welcome to your Suite

This is one workspace for all your files. Pick a file on the left and it opens in the right tool — Docs, Notes, Sheets and Wireframes all live together here.

Make a new file with the + buttons, or drop files into folders to keep things tidy.

files.name: Ideas
files.body:
**Quick note** — jot anything here.

- Notes are markdown with a live toolbar
- Docs are full rich text
- Sheets and Wireframes open as their own tool
- Everything shows up in this one file list
